category: debrid resale - Brazilian account shop (clone of the Daniel Contas Vip template)

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
binding_note: Same shape as contasvip at five centavos less; the binding constraint is the identity behind the login, not the price.
confidence_note: the seller's page was read today; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 30 days R$ 24.90, SKU RB030, sold as 'Conta Oficial' delivered as login data by email.
free_tier.notes: the page carries the same description, the same guarantee sentence and the same 2023 product image filename (15172081967_6d525702a8) as contasvip.com.br

egress.terms: no byte allowance published; vendor premium resold

limits.value: seller-held mailbox; new-location PIN goes to the seller

reliability_note: Two storefronts with identical copy and a shared image file are one supplier with two fronts; a warranty from either is the same warranty.

evidence.proved: R$ 24.90, SKU RB030, the guarantee sentence, and the delivery-by-email wording
the identical description and the same image filename, which is what makes the two shops one template

notes: Recorded separately from contasvip because the two are separate sellers with separate checkout, and a reader comparing Brazilian shops will meet both. The clone observation is the finding: the 'oficial' label is a template, not a licence.
